frozenBefore: any evaluation of outcomes collected by the observer on Render (collection on a persistent disk starts after this rule is committed)
statement: For each KXBTC15M market, the primary entry is the FIRST observed production prediction row with 0 < secondsRemaining <= 120 whose state is LOCKED (or PROVEN LOCKED) and whose reported reversal probability pFlip is <= 0.002 (0.2 % or lower, inclusive). At most one primary entry per market. The entry's side is the prediction; it is held to settlement and compared with Kalshi's official result. Later observations never replace the entry: losing LOCKED, pFlip rising above 0.002, a reversal warning or a direction flip after the entry stay in the primary result as separate events.

entryType.existing-lock: the last observed row before the final 120 s (within 10 s of it) already met the state and pFlip conditions on the same side
entryType.new-crossing: that row was observed and did not meet them
entryType.unknown-prior: no row was observed in the 10 s before the final 120 s

noEntry.no-qualifying-signal: every second of the final 120 s was observed and none qualified
noEntry.not-determinable: some second of the final 120 s was not observed: never counted as 'no signal' or as a success

timingCertain: true only if every second between the start of the final 120 s and the entry was observed (otherwise an earlier qualifying second may have been missed)
outcome: Kalshi's official result (status finalized); unresolved settlements are reported as unresolved, never as wins
exploratory: Any other rule (other thresholds, times, exits) is exploratory, must be versioned as a new file, and validated only on data collected after its own freeze date.
